notes.title: Update 0.5.0.0!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35021699/6ae82d5735600efac75c47af5a03326b91cdb908.png
Contents of this update

Defeating enemies generates experience, which is used to level up characters.
Implementation of clearing conditions.
Game design (modification to add character level-up)
Various adjustments to the combat portion of the game
Adjustment of UI


Description
Sorry it has been so long since the last update. We have made quite a few significant changes. The major topic is the addition of new clear conditions and character enhancements.
Changes to Clear Conditions
We have had the idea for the clear condition for a long time, but have not been able to implement it. This time, it is not yet in a perfect state, but it will be put in a problem-free state. There is no particular in-game explanation for the clear conditions, so that you have to guess.
Character Enhancement
The character can now be strengthened by acquiring points from enemies during battle, which can be upgraded in three different ways. First is the shape of the sword. This affects the attack range. Next is the mask. This is armor that automatically heals. Finally, special skill upgrades. Special skills acquired in the afterlife will have different abilities depending on the upgrade.
Others
Other changes include battle balance adjustment and various UI changes.

Add "this world" map, store, and refinement.

The contents of this update.

+ Added 1 MAP to "this world".
+ Refined the graphics of "this world".
+ Added the ability to perform a series of attacks (not combos).
+ Changed the balance of the battle (so that it is possible to fight one on one, but becomes difficult when fighting many).
+ Improved the character of the enemies (their attacks, speed, and durability are now more unique)
+ Changed the way to level up (instead of coins, you pay something else)
+ The number of items you can buy depends on how many coins you have.


In this update, we mainly added the MAP of "this world" and adjusted the balance of battle. It is easy to fight in one-on-one battles, but it becomes difficult when fighting against many. Level up and be ready for the enemy! We've also added items to aid in combat. These items can be purchased with coins. You can buy these items with coins, and the effect you get depends on the number of coins you buy. In the past, leveling up was done with coins, but from now on, you can level up by paying another price. Please check it out in the game.

We plan to add more maps and enhance the scenario in the future, so stay tuned!

In this update, the game design of that world has been changed drastically. You can now use elevators (with random destinations) to move between floors. Along with this, various systems have been adjusted.
In addition, we have made system fixes such as text speed, tutorial, skipping, etc., and general bug fixes.

The game design of "that world" has been changed and I think it's better. From now on, we will mainly work on "this world" and add more contents. Stay tuned!

Change of game design


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35021699/2133479d2247b5f3914ee35c276878c0146f1b39.png


attention
We've made quite a few changes, so bugs are to be expected.
Also, we've added a save feature, but that data may change in the future.
Depending on the content of the update, you may have to lose your data or restart the game anew.
If you don't want to take that risk, you may want to skip this update.

Also, no enemies or skills have been added, so I don't think there's any increase in fun.
However, the story has been added so you can get a more complete picture of the game.

We'll have more information about other information and future updates in due course.

With this update, I feel that the game has been completed to some extent. We also want to make minor corrections and quality improvements as needed.

It’s a game where you can enjoy try and error in a little time, so please try playing. Thank you.
